ينسحق (form VII)
# يَنْسَحِقُ (yansaḥiqu) /jan.sa.ħi.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# يَنْسَحِقَ (yansaḥiqa) /jan.sa.ħi.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# يَنْسَحِقْ (yansaḥiq) /jan.sa.ħiq/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
